Definition: Use electric wheelchairs and are quadriplegic.
Use electric wheelchairs and are quadriplegic. Have better upper body control when compared to CP1.
Use wheelchairs on a daily basis though they may be ambulant with the use of assistive devices. Have issues with head movement and trunk function.
Use wheelchairs on a daily basis though they may be ambulant with the use of assistive devices. Have fewer issues with head movement and trunk function.
Greater functional control of their upper body, and are generally ambulant with the use of an assistive device. Quick movements can upset their balance.
Ambulatory, and able to walk without the use of an assistive device. Their bodies are constantly in motion.
Able to walk, but may appear to have a limp as half their body is effected by cerebral palsy.
Least physically affected by their cerebral palsy, with their disability generally manifested as spasticity in at least one limb.
